changes: Prediction and current projection are parallel inputs to residual/feature construction.
Residual notation uses the same inherited prediction symbol μ; validity is not claimed to mean only finite values.
K/V no longer feed the local image features. Matching K/V tensors are reused in the attention expressions below.
Dot-product -> additive anatomical bias -> additive validity mask -> softmax over 17 keys per head.
Four headwise weighted-V outputs -> 4x32 concat -> zero-init output projection -> 24 feedback tokens.
Feedback enters per-joint fusion before anatomical part pooling; no direct W_o-to-Part/Time shortcut.
The long projection loop returns from updated rotations to current SMPL projection.

validated_semantics.mask: 0 for valid keys; negative infinity for invalid keys; all-invalid fallback is implementation detail outside the schematic
